d: Anant sinh ko jel jana hoga aur is bich unki vidhayki par bhi khatra mandra raha hai. halanki unki vidhanasbha ki sadasyata radd karne ka mamla spikar prem kumar ke hath men hai. prem kumar bijepi ke neta hain aise men ye kahna galat nahin hoga ki pura mamla bijepi ke kantrol men hai. ab dekhna hoga ki bijepi ispar kya karravi karti hai. agar anant sinh ke khilaph koee karravaee hoti hai to bijepi ko bhumihar varg ki narajgi ka bhi khatra hai. dekhie ye riport
